_comment: WARP-436 — RAGAS metric baselines, schema-only scaffold.
_status: PLACEHOLDER. Populate via the services/rag-eval/ container on a deployed appliance with COMPOSE_PROFILES=...,eval set: `docker exec droplet-rag-eval-1 python /opt/rag-eval/main.py bootstrap --runs 5` writes /data/rag-eval/baselines.candidate.json, then `docker cp` it back here and commit. See services/rag-eval/README.md + docs/RAG_TESTING.md §'Baselines + thresholds'. The integration test in tests/retrieval-eval/run.integration.test.ts treats the all-zero floors as 'recording mode' and skips assertions when zero.
_threshold_formula: floor = p50 − 1.5 × IQR, computed over 5 runs
